entities.name: Hénock Trouillot
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Henock Trouillot was a Haitian historian, playwright, and novelist. He wrote historical and sociological books, such as:Historiographie d'Haïti (1954)
La Condition des Nègres Domestiques à Saint-Domingue (1955)
Economie et Finances de Saint-Domingue (1965)
La Vengeance du Mapou (1967)
Le Gouvernement du Roi Henri Christophe (1974)
